chunks: And he, peace be upon him, said:
"Struggle against your desire just as you struggle against your enemy."

key_terms.جَاهِدْ: Strive and exert effort in struggle
key_terms.عَدُوَّكَ: Your enemy, used here as the point of comparison for vigilance and struggle
key_terms.هَوَاكَ: Your caprice, lower desire, or self-inclination

ai.seo_question: How does Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام describe struggling against one's desires?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches that a person's lower desires are an inner enemy requiring active struggle and discipline. It emphasizes moral self-mastery by comparing the fight against the nafs to confronting an external foe.
